reading.grounds: The player says the character arrived yesterday through a portal from another world. That is an arrival by a portal bridge, not an explicit statement that the character was already there.
reading.evidence_quote: through a portal from another world

assessments.grounds: The premise describes a quiet hamlet; it neither provides for nor excludes portals.
The canon says the place is invented; it says nothing about portals or other worlds.
A rule about the wind has no bearing on how the character is present.
The statement places the character at the same place the locus names.
